caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-sleeved, ankle-length robe or coat with a high, round collar. The garment is predominantly beige or light tan in color and is covered in a repeating pattern of small, brown and red floral or paisley motifs throughout the main areas, including the sleeves and the body. Down the front of the robe, running vertically from the collar to the hem, is a wide decorative stripe that consists of intricate geometric and floral designs in various colors including blue, red, and white, bordered by narrower bands containing similar motifs. The cuffs and collar also feature coordinated decorative borders that match the design of the central stripe. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, which draws attention to the detailed patterning and structure of the garment. The artwork appears to be executed with fine lines and watercolor or ink, and the lower right corner contains a signature.
title: Dressing Gown
